description: This file defines the SleepMode class used for managing device sleep modes, extending DSConstant, including static constants for sleep modes, and providing methods for instantiation and retrieving sleep mode instances.

classes.name: SleepMode
classes.description: Represents different sleep modes for device settings, encapsulating sleep mode identifiers and names, and providing instantiation and retrieval methods.

methods.name: SleepMode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a SleepMode instance with a specified ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a singleton instance of SleepMode given an ID or name.

methods.name: getSleepModes
methods.description: Returns a list of all available SleepMode instances.

ctags.name: kDeepSleep
ctags.pattern: /^	static const int kDeepSleep;   \/\/!< Indicates deep sleep mode.$/

ctags.name: kLightSleep
ctags.pattern: /^	static const int kLightSleep;  \/\/!< Indicates light sleep mode.$/

ctags.name: kMax
ctags.pattern: /^	static const int kMax;         \/\/!< Indicates maximum number of sleep modes supported.$/
